# SOP-P3-L1-04 Shift handover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03  
Related documents: MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1, MM-P3-L1-IH03, SOP-P3-L1-02

Purpose
1. Provide a standardized procedure for shift-to-shift handover on the Hot Forge line to ensure continuity of safe production, equipment integrity, and quality traceability.

Background and rationale
2. Proper handover prevents production interruptions and reduces the risk of equipment damage and quality escapes. The Hot Forge line contains the hydraulic forging press (EQ-P3-L1-HP01), the scraper/breakout station (EQ-P3-L1-SB02), and the induction billet heater (EQ-P3-L1-IH03). Critical conditions and recent maintenance actions must be communicated in a concise, verifiable format. Maintenance follow-up and operator awareness are required to preserve prior preventive actions documented in MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and MM-P3-L1-IH03, and to align with plant procedures in SOP-P3-L1-02.

Preconditions (must be met before handover begins)
3. Incoming operator has reviewed latest production order and quality hold tags.  
4. Outgoing operator has completed and signed all entries in the line log and maintenance request forms.  
5. Any active isolations or lockouts are documented per SOP-P3-L1-02 and clearly displayed at the equipment.  
6. Critical equipment status updates from recent maintenance are available from MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and MM-P3-L1-IH03.

Required PPE
7. All participants must wear required line PPE: safety glasses, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, flame-resistant clothing, and safety footwear. If maintenance personnel are present, they must also use any additional PPE mandated by MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 or MM-P3-L1-IH03.

Step-by-step handover procedure
8. Start: Conduct the handover at the designated line control point. Limit interruptions and use the standard handover checklist.

9. Operational status report (outgoing operator)
   9.1. Confirm current process step and part family running.  
   9.2. Report any deviations or quality holds, including sample location, serial identifiers, and containment actions taken.  
   9.3. Report production counts and scrap disposition recorded in the line log.

10. Equipment condition and alerts
   10.1. EQ-P3-L1-HP01: Report mechanical status, recent alarms, and whether a maintenance action from MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 is outstanding. Include confirmation of critical fastener condition: the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m. State whether the bolt torque has been verified and by whom.  
   10.2. EQ-P3-L1-IH03: Report electrical and cooling status and any interlock events; include process-critical coolant parameter: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min. Confirm measured flow and whether any maintenance from MM-P3-L1-IH03 is pending.  
   10.3. EQ-P3-L1-SB02: Report mechanical condition and any material handling issues, and confirm no jam conditions remain.

11. Process parameters and records
   11.1. Review the last run sheet and note any nonconformances recorded. Reference SOP-P3-L1-02 for escalation steps when out-of-spec conditions persist.  
   11.2. Confirm calibration status of measuring equipment used during the shift and note any out-of-calibration instruments referenced in the line log.

12. Maintenance and corrective actions
   12.1. List any open work orders and their status. Cross-reference maintenance documentation by id: MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and MM-P3-L1-IH03.  
   12.2. If an isolation is in place, confirm planned removal and responsible technician. Ensure the isolation record is available for the incoming shift to review.

13. Safety and housekeeping
   13.1. Confirm that housekeeping items on the line are addressed, including removal of loose debris and cleanup of spills.  
   13.2. Confirm that all guards and barriers are in place and functional. Note any temporary measures for which a follow-up corrective action exists.

14. Examples of concise handover statements
   14.1. “EQ-P3-L1-HP01: Ran part family X; encountered hydraulic pressure trip twice; main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m and was checked at start of shift by J. Smith; open work order for hydraulic leak.”  
   14.2. “EQ-P3-L1-IH03: Coil cooling flow recorded at shift end; The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min and current measured flow is within acceptable range; no interlock trips.”

15. Incoming operator actions
   15.1. Review all items reported by outgoing operator. Verify critical conditions physically before assuming process control.  
   15.2. Acknowledge understanding of open issues and immediate priorities; request clarifications as needed.  
   15.3. Update the line log to reflect acceptance of handover and any additional notes.

Records to keep
16. Line log: complete entries for production counts, quality holds, nonconformances, and signature blocks for outgoing and incoming operators.  
17. Equipment verification records: torque verification records for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 as referenced in MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1; cooling flow verification for EQ-P3-L1-IH03 as referenced in MM-P3-L1-IH03.  
18. Work orders: copies or references to open maintenance requests and completion confirmations.  
19. Handover checklist: completed checklist retained with line documentation and entered into the document control system per SOP-P3-L1-02.

Escalation
20. If any critical parameter cannot be verified or an unresolved safety hazard exists, stop the line and follow escalation in SOP-P3-L1-02. Notify maintenance per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and MM-P3-L1-IH03 as applicable.

Sign-off
21. Outgoing operator name, signature, date, shift.  
22. Incoming operator name, signature, date, shift.  
23. Supervisor verifier name, signature, date, and any conditional remarks.

Audit and continuous improvement
24. Handover records will be reviewed during routine audits. Patterns of recurring issues should generate corrective actions and potential updates to MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1, MM-P3-L1-IH03, or SOP-P3-L1-02.
